title: Evelyn's compliance pocket journal — SOC2 evidence & vendor triage
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad for evidence collection and vendor triage. Not polished — transfer to Confluence or attach to JIRA when ready.

Top priorities (this week) — quick view:
- [ ] Finish AcmeAnalytics vendor security questionnaire (SIG) and upload to s3 bucket. (ETA 2h)
- [ ] Pull Okta admin console logs for 2025-11 to 2026-02 for user provisioning evidence (log exports + redaction). (ETA 1.5h)
- [ ] Gather KMS key rotation policy + CMK rotation dates for prod encryption-at-rest evidence. (ETA 30m)
- [ ] Draft IR runbook updates: add escalation matrix and contact for cross-region failover testing. (ETA 2h)

Daily micro-tasks (scratch):
- check SIG form partials in email from acme-legal (mail thread: sec-vendor).
- note: AcmeAnalytics asked for our SOC2 cert PDF; send latest redacted copy (remove dev keys snippet).
- quick patch: add link to EKM proof-of-rotation in the audit bundle.

Evidence checklist (SOC2 target control groups):
- Access controls (A): MFA screenshots for admin accounts, Okta sign-in logs (exported), user-provisioning SAML asserts.
- Change mgmt (CC): change request PR list + approvals for 2025 Q4 — link to GH PRs.
- System configs (CC): KMS policies, disk encryption flags for all node pools, configmap snapshots.
- Vendor mgmt (CC): signed MSA + security questionnaire for top-5 vendors (AcmeAnalytics, DataLakeX, MetricsPro, CloudBackupCo, LogRouter).
- Incident response (T): IR exercises notes, postmortem templates, one table of recent incidents and status.

Quick commands / data pulls (notes for myself):
- Okta logs: aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/okta/2025-11-to-2026-02/ ./okta-logs --profile audit; run basic redaction script: tools/redact-okta.py okta-logs/ --pii-email
- KMS: aws kms list-keys --profile prod | grep -i cmk ; aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id>
- DB backups proof: /mnt/backups/pg/prod/manifest-2026-01.json (ask infra if missing)

Vendor triage: AcmeAnalytics (hot)
- Status: WIP (asked for network diagram + SOC2 pdf).
- Action: complete SIG v2, attach MSA, send redacted SOC2 PDF and KMS summary.
- Blocking: legal needs to OK redaction (cc: Priya).
- Send template email by EOD Tue.

Vendor triage: DataLakeX (medium)
- Status: need to confirm data retention + subprocessor list.
- Action: request subprocessors list / DPA. Add to vendor tracker spreadsheet.

Policy TODOs (for product and infra):
- retention-policy: finalize table for logs retention (90d vs 365d rationale). Draft to product-privacy for signoff.
- encryption-policy: clarify disk vs payload encryption expectations for Dedicated customers.
- incident-runbook: add canary tests for fallbacks to secondary region.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we accept vendor self-attestations for low-risk vendors or require SIG? (prev: low-risk allowed; suggest new threshold: expense > $20k or handles PII -> require SIG)
- Who owns KMS rotation proof? infra or security? (ask Ben infra)
- Can we include screenshot evidence in audit bundle or prefer logs? (auditors prefer logs + screenshots as supplemental)

Notes to self:
- When exporting logs, always checksum the file and store checksum alongside evidence. Use sha256sum and commit checksum into s3 metadata.
- Keep a tiny index file for each evidence bundle: bundle-index.txt with bullet points + pointers to raw exports.

Meeting prep for vendor sync (Wed 11am) — agenda:
1) Confirm AcmeAnalytics outstanding items (SIG fields, MSA question).
2) Retention policy alignment for DataLakeX.
3) Timeline for KMS rotation artifacts.
4) Quick wins: send SOC2 redacted PDF + link to audit bundle.

Personal schedule + timeboxing:
- Mon: SIG drafting (2h morning), okta logs export (1h afternoon).
- Tue: KMS docs + IR runbook edits (3h), send Acme email (30m).
- Wed: vendor sync 11am, follow-up notes + update tracker (1h).

Random thoughts / scratch (keep short):
- Could script a one-click bundle generator that pulls the list in bundle-index and zips evidence with checksums; maybe a small lambda + IAM role. Save as todo for infra-scripts.
- Consider a templated proof-of-rotation email from KMS to attach to vendor packages.

References / links to attach later:
- Confluence: /display/SEC/IR+Runbook (copy to linked artifacts)
- JIRA: JIRA-SEC-402 (vendor evidence tracker)
- GH PR: ops/PR#451 (change mgmt examples)

Last quick log: 2026-03-18 08:12 — exported okta logs, size 1.2GB, uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/evelyn/okta/; checksum: abc123... (add full sha when commit).

-- E.P.
